candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side metrics or logs; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s at ~2s align with order ReadTimeouts; traces show save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable while pool size 5 and idle 0, and order 503s propagate to gateway. Pool exhaustion on order->postgres is the bounded leading cause; postgres-side metrics and logs are still needed to confirm.
missing_evidence: Postgres server metrics (active/idle connections, wait time) to confirm pool saturation
Order service logs for pool acquisition timeouts
